facts: Pump.fun said a former employee used privileged access and flash loans in an exploit.
The platform reported approximately 12,300 SOL, valued around USD 1.9 million at the time, was affected.
Trading was halted while the platform upgraded contracts.
impact: asset-level signals alone could not establish execution safety
designImplication: Execution authority must include provider health and fresh evidence, not only token-level scoring.
mitigationInBuild: live ClawPump provider/linked-agent preflight before quote/build
provider/freshness denial stored as a REJECT receipt
PREPARE remains distinct from verified execution
